segments.he: אָמַר שְׁבִיתָתִי בְּעִיקָּרוֹ — מְהַלֵּךְ מִמְּקוֹם רַגְלָיו וְעַד עִיקָּרוֹ אַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה, וּמֵעִיקָּרוֹ לְבֵיתוֹ אַלְפַּיִם אַמָּה. נִמְצָא מְהַלֵּךְ מִשֶּׁחָשֵׁיכָה אַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים אַמָּה.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that if, however, «he said: My residence is at» the «trunk» of the tree, he established residence there, and he «may walk from the place that he is standing to the trunk» of the tree, up to «two thousand cubits, and from the trunk» of the tree «to his house» another «two thousand cubits. Ultimately, he may walk after nightfall» a total distance of «four thousand cubits.»
